purpose: Judge something as unexpected for a stated category or circumstance.
keywords: Plain form + にしては; noun / な-adjective stem + にしては
It is a warm day for winter.
It turned out well for a first attempt.
It is durable considering how cheap it was.
formation: Plain form + にしては; noun / な-adjective stem + にしては
restrictions: The first clause gives a known benchmark, not just a hypothetical.
mistake: 子どもにしては can sound patronizing; use with care when praising someone.
